name: [COPYCAT] - ULTRA Battlegrounds
desc:
"i'm going to ULTRAKILL you!!!" (tell that to your friends)
more like ultra shenanigans. 

--[HOW TO PLAY]--
M1 - basic attack
1, 2, 3, 4 - abilities
Q - dash/tech (side + back dashes have invincibility)
F - block
G - ult
yellow = parryable, blue = unparryable, red = unblockable


/// [6/6/2025 - The Interim Update pt. 2.3] ///

- Added failsafes for some characters i-frames not expiring
- probably finally actually fixed the join invincible bug for real this time (fr)
